sampling_method: All returned records in the frozen official query, ordered by source start date, until pagination ends or declared maximum. Source availability/changes may affect coverage.
date_policy: Preserve exact/year/month source strings and ACTUAL/ESTIMATED types; no date imputation.
enrollment_policy: planned_enrollment uses only explicitly ESTIMATED enrollment; reported/current enrollment is not an original plan.
eligibility_feature_method: Lexical nonempty-line, Unicode-word and character counts from eligibility text; not counts of clinical conditions.
site_policy: Counts refer to locations/countries present in this current source projection; not planned sites or recruitment performance.
data_use: Public ClinicalTrials.gov registry records; cite the source and review its terms. No blanket third-party text license is asserted.
limitations: Current snapshots do not prove trial-start feature availability.
Completed-only drug-trial scope omits censored outcomes and does not represent all trials.
No patient-level data, original planned completion, treatment benefit or clinical validation is inferred.
First-registered date is not a timestamp for every current feature.
Counts are an acquisition inventory; training eligibility and temporal purging must be reported separately.
